title: Create SMP Float
description: Create based modpack that contains a lot of additions and quality of life mods!
body:
This is a modpack made to get the **BEST** Create Mod experience!

**_THIS IS NOT A VANILLA+ MODPACK!!!_**

**Explanation :**
  While this might seem like a big modpack, it is mostly made of optimisation mods

**Personal Experience :**
  This modpack is best to play with friends, but you can still play solo if you don't have any!


_I do not affiliate with the Create Mod creators or creators of any mods in this modpack._
